title: Alternatives to Process Management Tools Beyond a Fixed Kanban Board
summary: Explore alternatives to process management tools beyond a fixed Kanban board, with neutral criteria for choosing.
body_markdown:
There are several **alternatives to process management tools** when a simple Kanban board no longer covers the operation: tools like Notion, Airtable, ClickUp, Pipefy, Monday, and **Jestor** come up in this search, each with a different level of automation, integration, and process flexibility.


The search for alternatives usually starts when a team notices it's adapting the real process to fit the tool's format, instead of the other way around.


This is common in fast-growing companies: what was simple to manage on a board turns into a sequence of exceptions the board can't represent.


## Signs It's Worth Looking for an Alternative


- The process has conditional steps that a simple Kanban board doesn't represent well
- The team uses parallel spreadsheets to cover what the current tool leaves out
- There's no native integration with the company's ERP, finance, or WhatsApp
- Automations depend on external tools, like Zapier or Make, with added cost
- The operation's growth demands more permission control than the current tool offers


## What to Evaluate in Each Alternative


- Whether the tool allows conditional fields and steps, without needing a card for every exception
- Whether automations are native or depend on separately paid external connectors
- Whether it's possible to structure relational data, beyond simple boards and lists
- Whether integration with the company's existing ERP is native or requires an intermediary


Operational need What to look for in the tool


Processes with exceptions and conditional rules Native conditional fields and steps


Finance integrated with the process Native ERP integration


Customer communication within the workflow WhatsApp integrated into the card or record


Team growth and added complexity Granular permissions by role and field


## Where Jestor Stands Out Among These Alternatives


- Native conditional fields and steps, including what shows on the card's cover, without needing a card for every exception
- More than 400 native **automations** , covering what would normally require Zapier, Make, or another intermediary
- Native integration with **Omie** , **Conta Azul** , and **WhatsApp Business** , without leaving the tool
- A relational table structure behind the Kanban board, for data that outgrows what a simple board can hold


## Frequently asked questions


**Does every growing company need to switch process tools?** Not always, but processes with many exceptions tend to call for a more flexible tool.


**Does Jestor also work as a simple Kanban board?** Yes, the Kanban view is still available in **Jestor** ; see more features at[jestor.com](https://www.jestor.com/?ref=blog.jestor.com) .


**Are external automations, like Zapier, still needed with Jestor?** Rarely, since most common automations are already native.


**Can I migrate gradually, process by process?** Yes, it's possible to start with one specific process before migrating the whole operation.


Knowing the **alternatives to process management tools** available helps you choose by the right criteria, not just by the look of the interface.
